method: Native Tkinter app, launched against an isolated temporary SQLite database; user database untouched.

checks.name: Tab traversal
checks.detail: Focus traversed visible fields through page count and featured checkbox; hidden repository/server fields were skipped for the selected project type.

checks.name: Shift+Tab traversal
checks.detail: Reverse traversal returned through visible fields to title; screenshots and focus history retained.

checks.name: Multiline Enter
checks.detail: Enter inserted a new line in the description field; screenshot retained.

checks.name: Ctrl+Enter save
checks.detail: Isolated test saved one synthetic project; temporary SQLite database showed project count 4 from initial 3. The production user database was not used.

checks.name: Small-window focus visibility
checks.detail: At 720x480 the checkbox is fully visible after focus-triggered scroll with a 12-pixel breathing margin.

regression_tests: Python/SQLite 81/81 passed after the margin fix.
